integrity: The complete theorem combines a smooth genus-21 curve point bound with an exact exhaustive prime census; no computational extrapolation is used, and no independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields only; both variables may vanish; no assertion about representation multiplicities, extension fields or prime-power rings. Exact finite exceptions were enumerated by a reproducible Python checker; the infinite part relies on Hasse--Weil. A potentially relevant 2022 undergraduate thesis was not inspected in full. An uncatalogued equivalent classification remains possible.
title: The sharp prime-field covering threshold for two eighth powers
